items.detail: Listed probable with right knee soreness and expected to suit up as the starting PG; no minutes limit reported (he played 33 min Sunday vs ATL), though one later preview table shows him questionable, so confirm at tip.
Questionable with an illness after missing the last two games (doubtful then ruled out both times over the weekend); real doubt he plays at Denver.
Started both weekend games in place of P.J. Washington (27:41, 15 pts, 8 reb at Utah) and is the likeliest starter again if Washington sits, a bigger role than his bench projection.
Mitchell Robinson is out with an illness for a third straight game, so Queta is the projected starting center with a larger frontcourt role.

note: Evening run before confirmed lineups. Denver lists no injuries and Julian Strawther (not in the rotation list) is set for his season debut, which could trim DEN bench minutes. Banchero (ankle/illness) and Duren (hamstring) remain out. No reason found for the Jalen Suggs or Kyrie Irving model gaps: no injury, rest or minutes-limit news on either. Nothing new on Bane, Carter Jr., Pritchard, Gordon or Flagg; Yahoo projects Jordan Walsh, not Pritchard, starting for BOS. Open bets are non-NBA.
